# Model card: Value lens

`value` · version 1.0.0 · owner Avinash Tallam · status active

## Intended use

- Rank NSE-listed operating companies by price against earning power, quality, balance sheet, growth and governance, once a month.
- Pick the valuation anchor from the stock's sector profile (banks on P/B and ROE, airlines on EV/EBITDAR, order-book names on order cover, and so on).

## Not intended for

- Intraday or short-term timing (that is the momentum lens).
- Pre-profit or very young companies: the lens turns informational (Fair-value row, Low confidence, 'limited history') instead of forcing a score.
- Producing a price target. Fair-value ranges are the reverse-DCF and multiple anchors, not forecasts.

## Inputs

- Config: `config/value.yaml` (hash `ff785ab0`).
- 61 registered metrics (see [METRICS.md](../METRICS.md)), e.g. `MET.value.car`, `MET.value.casa`, `MET.value.cash_runway_months`, `MET.value.cfo_to_ebitda_3y`.

## Assumptions

- Statements are consolidated and come from the Screener export, cross-checked against exchange XBRL; they are visible only after their publication date (point-in-time).
- Normalised earnings use a multi-year average to dampen cycles; the archetype (cyclical, compounder, turnaround and so on) sets the weights.
- Missing metrics are dropped and weights re-normalised; confidence falls one level per 15% of weight missing.

## Limitations

- Peer and sector-relative context is not loaded yet (Phase 3), so 'vs sector' columns are N/A.
- Profile inputs the Screener export lacks (lease liabilities, customer advances, listed stakes) come from exchange filings via `parakh profile-inputs`; an order book and offer-document financials are Phase 2 document inputs, and until they are loaded those metrics are N/A.
- Checks that need filings or event feeds (auditor changes, surveillance lists, related-party items) are ❔ UNKNOWN until Phase 3, and never counted as clean.
- All thresholds and weights are starting assumptions; calibration is Phase 5.

## Validation

Pending: UAT-1 (plan 14) checks the pilot reports; Phase 5 calibrates thresholds against outcomes.
